title: Command Pattern with Undo/Redo in TypeScript
title_es: Command Pattern con Undo/Redo en TypeScript
description: Companion code for the Command pattern with undo/redo: a two-stack CommandHistory, inverse commands for a text document, MacroCommand grouping, async CommandQueue, and bounded history — runnable with Node type stripping.
description_es: Código companion del patrón Command con undo/redo: CommandHistory con dos pilas, comandos inversos para un documento de texto, MacroCommand, CommandQueue async e historial acotado — ejecutable con type stripping de Node.
